newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chi Cheung to buy property agent.
newsitem.headline: Chi Cheung to buy property agent.

text.p: Chi Cheung investment Co Ltd said on Monday it signed a letter of intent with the majority shareholders of property agency Ricacorp Properties Ltd to provide a framework to finalise terms for various agreements leading to Ricacorp becoming a 51 percent unit of Chi Cheung.
The completion of the agreements expected to be entered into on or before October 30, it said in a statement.

Chi Cheung said Ricacorp would buy the entire interest in a real estate agency business currently operated by a non-wholly owned subsidiary of Chi Cheung through an issue of new Ricacorp shares to a wholly-owned subsidiary of Chi Cheung.
Chi Cheung said its wholly-owned subsidiary would acquire additional shares in Ricacorp from the majority shareholder of Ricacorp for an undisclosed sum of cash.
Following the agreements, Ricacorp would operate a real estate agency business with over 90 branches and be a 51 percent subsidiary of Chi Cheung.
The combined overheads of the enlarged business of Ricacorp were exepected to be reduced significantly, Chi Cheung, the property and financial investment company said.
